items.evidence_quote: Paul Stamets explains how mushrooms support immune defense and brain health, and what clinical research shows about psilocybin's benefits, risks and safety.

figure.quote_en: Paul Stamets explains how mushrooms support immune defense and brain health, and what clinical research shows about psilocybin's benefits, risks and safety.
figure.summary_zh: Huberman 訪問真菌學家 Paul Stamets，談蘑菇如何支援免疫系統與腦部健康，以及裸蓋菇素對抑鬱、焦慮等精神健康問題的臨床研究證據、風險與安全須知。

items.evidence_quote: This release adds support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints

figure.quote_en: This release adds support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so you can configure Datasette to use an LLM hosted anywhere that talks the OpenAI pseudo-standard web protocol.
figure.summary_zh: Simon 發布 datasette-llm 0.1a11，新增支援 OpenAI 兼容端點，Datasette Agent 可接駁 LM Studio、Ollama 或 llama.cpp 等本地模型運作。

items.evidence_quote: The first new Datasette geospatial plugin in quite a while!

figure.quote_en: The first new Datasette geospatial plugin in quite a while! This one combines the excellent MapLibre GL library with OpenFreeMap, the free vector map server
figure.summary_zh: Simon 發布首個新 Datasette 地理插件 datasette-maplibre 0.1a0，結合 MapLibre GL 與免費向量地圖伺服器 OpenFreeMap，可在地圖上顯示 GeoJSON 圖形與經緯度點。

items.evidence_quote: The biggest 1.0 item in this release is streaming support for output renderers

figure.quote_en: The biggest 1.0 item in this release is streaming support for output renderers
figure.summary_zh: Simon 發布 Datasette 1.0a43，1.0 里程碑已完成 53%，最大新功能是輸出渲染器的串流支援，另修復兩處安全問題，包括私人儲存查詢可能外洩的漏洞。

items.evidence_quote: Notable supporters include Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk

figure.quote_en: Jensen deserves due process, not mob justice
figure.summary_zh: 馬斯克聯署要求 Nvidia 董事會恢復黃仁勳 CEO 職務的公開信。截至 11 月 14 日已有逾 11.5 萬人聯署，包括近 6,000 名 Nvidia 現職員工與逾 6.3 萬名股東；請願網站列明馬斯克於 11 月 13 日以股東身份簽署。

items.evidence_quote: Dr. Fei-Fei Li joins AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist.

figure.quote_en: Dr. Fei-Fei Li joins AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist, reporting directly to Su.
figure.summary_zh: AMD 宣布完成收購李飛飛創辦的 World Labs，李飛飛出任 AMD 執行副總裁兼首席科學家，直接向 CEO Lisa Su 匯報。交易於 11 月 13 日完成，AMD 為此發行近 1,498 萬股新股。

items.evidence_quote: there is a 1 in 3 chance that we could have superintelligence powerful enough to overthrow the government within a year

figure.quote_en: I would say we are looking more like a 10% risk than a 1% risk over the next year.
figure.summary_zh: Dwarkesh 訪問對齊研究中心負責人 Paul Christiano。Christiano 認為若不放緩，未來一年內出現足以推翻政府的超級智能約有三分之一機會，並主張實驗室應暫停演算法進展，直至模型權重與研究機密得到保障。

items.evidence_quote: We track every data center in the world, and as a firm, we know more about data centers than anyone else.

figure.quote_en: We've got people in 15 countries. There are about 115 people, with offices in New York, Chicago, San Francisco, Oregon, Singapore, and Korea.
figure.summary_zh: Dylan Patel 接受 Sourcery 訪問，談 SemiAnalysis 已擴至 115 人、15 個國家，追蹤全球數據中心，並評論黃仁勳離任對 Nvidia 與 AI 基建的餘波，以及他新設的 5 億美元創投基金。
